strings.name: Brian L. Roberts
strings.role: Media executive · Comcast chairman and co-CEO
strings.summary: Roberts joined his father’s Comcast in 1981, expanding from cable into broadband, television networks, film and international pay TV. As president, CEO and chairman he oversaw transactions involving AT&T Broadband, NBCUniversal and Sky. In 2026 he adopted a co-CEO structure with Cavanagh and completed the Versant separation amid changing streaming and television markets.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Led Comcast and integrated broadband, television and film assets, influencing the US media market.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born 28 June 1959 in Philadelphia, United States.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Bachelor’s degree, Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania(1981).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Communications and media
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led expansion from cable into broadband, networks, film and international businesses.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Transactions and restructuring
strings.highlights.h2.text: Oversaw NBCUniversal and Sky acquisitions and the Versant separation, changing the asset portfolio.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Co-CEO structure
strings.timeline.t1.text: Cavanagh became co-CEO in January; Roberts remained chairman and co-CEO.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Versant separation
strings.timeline.t2.text: Comcast distributed Versant shares on 2 January, separating selected cable networks and other businesses.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Sky acquisition
strings.timeline.t3.text: Comcast acquired Sky, expanding European pay-TV and content operations.
strings.timeline.t4.title: NBCUniversal control
strings.timeline.t4.text: Comcast acquired a controlling stake, later purchasing the remaining shares.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Chairman
strings.timeline.t5.text: Added the group chairmanship to his CEO responsibilities.
strings.timeline.t6.title: CEO and broadband transaction
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became CEO; Comcast also completed the AT&T Broadband acquisition that year.
strings.timeline.t7.title: President
strings.timeline.t7.text: Became Comcast president, taking broader operational responsibility.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joined Comcast
strings.timeline.t8.text: Joined the family-founded company after graduating from Wharton.
